methodology: Twelve new multi-outcome/source conditions authored independently from old answer expectations; hand-calculated route/policy/VRF/protocol outcomes. Source-derived, implementation-assistant graded, not blind/external.

grading.fully_adequate: Every requested outcome correct and useful, no significant unsupported claim; model self-assessments and fallback do not prove reasoning.

cases.prompt: Assess the recorded TCP/9443 forward and return service from Harbor to Meadow. Explain Transit's selected path versus its other route, and the actual scope of the delivery result. Use recorded state only.
expected_claims: Both directions delivered via Transit Ethernet1/2 and Meadow Ethernet2/1
Transit15preference route selected over25, not ECMP
Only simulated declared service, no physical proof
prohibited_claims: Unavailable observations prove no event or prove operational health
cases.full_adequacy: All clauses correct with source/identity/scope and a useful explanation; no significant unsupported claim; structural self-assessment alone earns no credit.

cases.prompt: Investigate the Harbor–Meadow TCP/9443 failure using recorded state and current configuration only. Explain the failed forward and return interfaces, whether no shutdown proves delivery, and what cannot be diagnosed.
expected_claims: Forward stops at Meadow Ethernet2/1 ingress operdown/adminup; return egress on same interface
Current no shutdown not operational proof; no asserted cable/root physical cause
prohibited_claims: Unavailable observations prove no event or prove operational health
cases.full_adequacy: All clauses correct with source/identity/scope and a useful explanation; no significant unsupported claim; structural self-assessment alone earns no credit.

cases.prompt: Compare both equal-cost forward branches for Harbor to Meadow UDP/4789 and the return direction. Explain whether this establishes a total outage or a measured packet-loss percentage. Read state only; do not read configuration.
expected_claims: Transit Ethernet1/2 egress policy denies one equal-cost branch; Ethernet1/3 delivers
Forwardpartial,returndelivered via MeadowEthernet2/2; no inventedpercentage orprimarypriority
prohibited_claims: Unavailable observations prove no event or prove operational health
cases.full_adequacy: All clauses correct with source/identity/scope and a useful explanation; no significant unsupported claim; structural self-assessment alone earns no credit.

cases.prompt: Explain Harbor to Meadow forwarding in violet versus the recorded default-VRF route at Transit. Explain the reverse direction separately. Read state only and make no configuration changes.
prohibited_claims: Unavailable observations prove no event or prove operational health
cases.full_adequacy: All clauses correct with source/identity/scope and a useful explanation; no significant unsupported claim; structural self-assessment alone earns no credit.

cases.prompt: Compare Transit current configuration with its saved capture. Explain the significant command change and inspect available syslog. Explain what the two sources cannot tell us about the reason or timing. Use only configuration and syslog.
prohibited_claims: Unavailable observations prove no event or prove operational health
cases.full_adequacy: All clauses correct with source/identity/scope and a useful explanation; no significant unsupported claim; structural self-assessment alone earns no credit.

cases.prompt: Compare recorded OSPF and BGP peers between Harbor and Transit. Explain which local/remote values agree or disagree, and what the recorded states do and do not establish. Read state only.
prohibited_claims: Unavailable observations prove no event or prove operational health
cases.full_adequacy: All clauses correct with source/identity/scope and a useful explanation; no significant unsupported claim; structural self-assessment alone earns no credit.

cases.prompt: Explain Harbor saved OSPF and BGP capture, including the router ID, local AS, neighbor, remote AS and marker. Explain which effective router ID is not established by that text. Use saved configuration only, with no operational queries.
prohibited_claims: Unavailable observations prove no event or prove operational health
cases.full_adequacy: All clauses correct with source/identity/scope and a useful explanation; no significant unsupported claim; structural self-assessment alone earns no credit.

cases.prompt: Map the planned Harbor–Transit–Meadow interfaces. Explain whether the unavailable recorded state lets you confirm current TCP/9443 delivery or an outage. Use planned topology and state only.
prohibited_claims: Unavailable observations prove no event or prove operational health
cases.full_adequacy: All clauses correct with source/identity/scope and a useful explanation; no significant unsupported claim; structural self-assessment alone earns no credit.

cases.prompt: Investigate the reported Transit uplink problem, starting with its saved configuration and planned links. Explain the present recorded condition and its recorded intent if relevant existing records can establish them; follow a material source reference when necessary. Do not test or change devices.
cases.adaptive_condition: Material present-state/intent gap; model may prefetch or propose a bounded supplementary query, never forced.
prohibited_claims: Unavailable observations prove no event or prove operational health
cases.full_adequacy: All clauses correct with source/identity/scope and a useful explanation; no significant unsupported claim; structural self-assessment alone earns no credit.

cases.prompt: Using that owned context, recommend two next diagnostic checks and explain what different explanations each could distinguish. Do not read, collect, test or change anything now.
expected_claims: Recordedintent/changehistory and conditionalpost-enableoper/physical observations appropriate, noactionsperformed
cases.setup: Read Transit current configuration, including Ethernet1/2.
cases.adaptive_condition: No-read advisory with owned successful config context.
prohibited_claims: Unavailable observations prove no event or prove operational health
cases.full_adequacy: All clauses correct with source/identity/scope and a useful explanation; no significant unsupported claim; structural self-assessment alone earns no credit.

cases.prompt: Compare the Harbor to Meadow forward result and the reverse evidence. Explain whether the empty incomplete reverse table proves there is no route, and recommend a useful next recorded check without collecting it. Use state only.

cases.full_adequacy: All clauses correct with source/identity/scope and a useful explanation; no significant unsupported claim; structural self-assessment alone earns no credit.
